name: i2v.ai
description: Generate images and videos across 12 image and 16 video models from one hosted MCP server, with a USD quote before every paid task and a caller-set spending ceiling.
author: i2v.ai

localizations.name: i2v.ai
localizations.description: 一个托管 MCP 服务器，覆盖 12 个图片模型与 16 个视频模型；每个付费任务先返回美元报价，并可设置消费上限。

tools.name: list_models
tools.title: List generation models
tools.description: List public i2v.ai image/video generation models that can be submitted right now. Returns the public modelId, price variants, and pagination. Only published models with an available i2v runtime are returned. Call get_model_params for one model before create_task.

category.description: Catalog category or task type, such as image-generation, image-to-video, or video-editing.

search.description: Case-insensitive search of public IDs, labels, aliases, brands and tags.

tools.name: get_model_params
tools.title: Get model parameters
tools.description: Return the parameter contract for one public model: a JSON Schema (when the source schema is convertible), field defaults/options, and media slot limits. Use this before estimate_cost or create_task.

tools.name: recommend_models
tools.title: Recommend generation models
tools.description: Find up to three published models for a task and relevant media constraints. If a model is explicitly requested, evaluate only that model. Confirm a recommendation with prepare_generation before spending.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.title: Estimate task cost
tools.description: Return the USD cost for one task without creating an order or reserving funds. Uses the same API pricing channel as create_task (the same account entitlements apply to Web, REST and MCP). Call this before create_task.

inputs.description: Same inputs object you would pass to create_task.

tools.name: prepare_generation
tools.title: Validate and quote a task without submitting it
tools.description: Check actual model inputs and return normalized settings and the current maximum USD reservation. This tool does not upload files, create tasks or reserve funds. Pass the returned expectedRevision and an approved cap to create_task.

tools.name: create_upload_url
tools.title: Create upload URL
tools.description: Use an existing public URL, or get a presigned R2 PUT URL for one image/video/audio file. With fileName, PUT the raw bytes to uploadUrl using the returned Content-Type, then pass url in create_task inputs (for example imageUrls). Complete the upload with complete_upload before attaching the owned asset to a task. This call does not transfer the file itself.

url.description: Existing public http(s) URL. Use this instead of fileName when you already host the asset.

fileName.description: Original file name; its extension determines the accepted type.

tools.name: complete_upload
tools.title: Complete media upload
tools.description: Verify an uploaded owned object before using its URL.

tools.name: create_task
tools.title: Create generation task
tools.description: Submit one generation task. RESERVES USD BALANCE and calls an upstream provider. Returns a taskId; poll get_task until status is success or fail. Call prepare_generation first and pass its expectedRevision, the approved maxCostUsd and a stable idempotencyKey. Pass maxCostUsd to reject a reservation above the approved budget.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for retries of the same logical request.

expectedRevision.description: Model revision returned by prepare_generation. Reject a different published revision.

recoveryScope.description: For a new OAuth submission, enable recovery only within this client connection. Preserve this value on replay.

maxCostUsd.description: Reject the task if the charged USD would exceed this decimal string.

tools.name: get_task
tools.title: Get task status
tools.description: Read one task. status: waiting | generating | success | fail. On success, output contains the asset URLs; on fail, error contains a code and message. Poll with backoff (for example 5s, then 10s, then 20s) instead of a tight loop.

tools.name: recover_submission
tools.title: Recover a submission receipt without submitting again
tools.description: Find a durable receipt by the original idempotency key using the same API key or OAuth client. OAuth submissions must have used recoveryScope=connection.

tools.name: get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Return the authenticated user's email, name, USD available and reserved balance, and the connection's scopes.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.title: Read USD account usage
tools.description: Read account-wide settled charges, refunds and net USD usage by UTC booking date. Default range is 30d. Pending reservations are reported by get_account.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.title: Search documentation
tools.description: Search the public i2v.ai docs for concepts, parameter names, error codes, upload rules, and API/MCP usage. Returns matching pages with a snippet; open the returned URL for the full page. Does not read account data or run models.

query.description: Keywords, for example: upload expiry, insufficient_balance, duration.

prompts.name: generate_image
prompts.title: Generate an image
prompts.description: Pick an image model, quote the price, then submit one image task and return the output URL.

prompts.name: generate_video
prompts.title: Generate a video
prompts.description: Choose a video model, quote the price, then submit a text-to-video or image-to-video task.

prompts.name: budget_check
prompts.title: Check budget before generating
prompts.description: Read the balance and recent usage, then recommend what fits the remaining budget.
